heading: Taxation of a domestic international sales corporation
lead: For purposes of the taxes imposed by this subtitle upon a DISC (as defined in section 992(a)), a DISC shall not be subject to the taxes imposed by this subtitle.

notes.text: Amendments1998—Pub. L. 105–206 struck out “except for the tax imposed by chapter 5” before period at end.
